description: Move items to the top of another layer, or of the active layer when layer is omitted (Object > Arrange > Send to Current Layer)

layer.description: Top-level layer name. Default the active layer

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: move_items_to_layer
title: Move Items To Layer
